'''Zero-point energy''', also known as '''null-point energy''' or '''vacuum energy''', was the lowest possible energy that a quantum mechanical physical system could have.

Zero-point energy was also known as null-point energy, and was utilized in the power source of the experimental [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Battle Lance]]''.

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Timothy Zahn]] used this to explain away the criticism that [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] fly like [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] fighters&mdash;banking and turning&mdash;when the vacuum of space wouldn't allow that. He assumed that [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] meant space-foils and assumed they were pressing against the universe's vacuum energy, sometimes called zero-point energy.
